inputs.question: What are the member and storage limits of Free?
inputs.context:
# CloudDesk plans, version 1

CloudDesk is a fictional workspace SaaS used for a controlled support evaluation. All prices and policies in this corpus are synthetic, not commercial offers.

## PLAN-01: Plans and billing
Free supports at most 3 members and 1 GB of workspace storage. Free has no API access.
Team costs USD 12 per billable seat per month on monthly billing, or USD 120 per billable seat per year on annual billing. Team has a minimum of 5 billable seats, 100 GB of workspace storage, and API access.
Business costs USD 25 per billable seat per month on monthly billing, or USD 240 per billable seat per year on annual billing. Business has a minimum of 10 billable seats, 1 TB of workspace storage, API access, and SAML SSO.
Annual prices are charged upfront for the full year. Prices exclude taxes. A member occupies a billable seat; a read-only guest does not. Minimum billable seats still apply even when there are fewer members.

## PLAN-02: Plan changes
An upgrade takes effect immediately and the unused portion of the old plan is credited against the prorated charge for the new plan. A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Removing a member does not refund the current period; the next renewal uses the new member count, subject to the plan minimum.

outputs.answer: Free permits up to 3 members and 1 GB of workspace storage. [PLAN-01]

metadata.reference_rationale: Direct lookup of both Free limits.

inputs.question: If the owner cancels renewal today, do paid features stop immediately and is workspace data deleted?
inputs.context:
# CloudDesk billing policy, version 1

## BILL-01: Cancellation and refunds
The workspace owner can cancel renewal in Settings > Billing. Cancellation prevents the next renewal and paid features remain available until the current paid period ends. Cancellation does not delete workspace data.
A refund is available only for the first paid subscription charge when the owner submits a request within 14 elapsed days (336 hours) of that charge, inclusive. This applies to monthly and annual subscriptions. Renewal charges, add-ons, and requests after 336 hours are not eligible under the standard policy. Canceling renewal does not itself submit a refund request. Refund requests go to billing@clouddesk.example with the workspace ID and invoice number. An approved refund returns to the original payment method in 5-10 business days. The assistant can explain eligibility but cannot approve, submit, or execute refunds.

## BILL-02: Invoices and tax
Owners and billing admins can download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Only the owner can cancel renewal. Tax identification changes apply to future invoices. Previously issued invoices cannot be edited through self-service; billing support must review them. No tax rate is specified in this document.

outputs.answer: No. Paid features remain until the current paid period ends, and cancellation does not delete workspace data. It stops the next renewal. [BILL-01]

metadata.reference_rationale: Cancellation, access expiry, and data deletion are distinct.

inputs.question: I lost my MFA device but still have an unused recovery code. What is the recovery route?
inputs.context:
# CloudDesk access policy, version 1

## ACCESS-01: Account recovery
A user with a lost MFA device can sign in using an unused recovery code. If no recovery code is available, the user must contact security@clouddesk.example for identity verification. A workspace admin cannot bypass MFA. Support never requests passwords, MFA codes, or recovery codes in a chat or email. The assistant cannot disable MFA or verify identities.

## ACCESS-02: Roles and SSO
Only a workspace owner can transfer ownership or cancel renewal. Admins can invite and remove members but cannot perform those owner-only actions. A billing admin can download invoices but cannot cancel renewal. SAML SSO is available only on Business. Enforcement requires a verified company domain and an owner to configure it. An owner locked out by SSO must use the security support recovery process; bypass is not guaranteed.

outputs.answer: Sign in using the unused recovery code. Keep the code private; support never asks for it in chat or email. [ACCESS-01]

metadata.reference_rationale: Recovery-code path without collecting secrets.

inputs.question: Will the CSV workspace export contain our file attachments?
inputs.context:
# CloudDesk data policy, version 1

## DATA-01: Export and deletion
Owners and admins can export workspace records as CSV from Settings > Data > Export. Exported CSV files do not include file attachments. Attachments must be downloaded separately before deletion. Only the owner can request workspace deletion. Deletion has a 7-day grace period during which the owner can cancel the request. After the grace period ends, active workspace data is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered through support. Billing cancellation and workspace deletion are separate operations.

## DATA-02: Residency and unavailable details
A workspace's primary storage region is chosen as EU or US at creation and cannot be changed through self-service. A migration request requires support review; approval is not guaranteed. This policy does not specify backup retention duration, backup locations, HIPAA eligibility, or a maximum export file size. These details require confirmation from support. The assistant has no access to a customer's live workspace or export status.

outputs.answer: No. The CSV export contains workspace records but excludes attachments. Download attachments separately before deletion. [DATA-01]

metadata.reference_rationale: CSV scope excludes attachments.

inputs.question: What should my Team client do after an HTTP 429 response with Retry-After: 20?
inputs.context:
# CloudDesk API and support policy, version 1

## API-01: Current API limits
This is the current policy. Team allows 60 API requests per minute per workspace. Business allows 300 requests per minute per workspace. Limits are shared by all API keys in that workspace. Free has no API access. HTTP 429 means the request exceeded the limit. Respect the Retry-After header before retrying, and use exponential backoff if that header is absent. Repeated immediate retries are not recommended.
An archived 2024 article stated that Team allowed 100 requests per minute. That article is superseded by this current 60-request limit.

## SUPPORT-01: Support coverage
Email support operates Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00 UTC, excluding public holidays. Team has a next-business-day first-response target. Business has a 4-business-hour first-response target. These are first-response targets, not resolution guarantees. No plan includes a guaranteed weekend response under this policy. The assistant cannot create tickets, inspect live service status, or promise resolution times. For an active incident, the customer can contact support@clouddesk.example and include a workspace ID and the observed error.

outputs.answer: Wait at least 20 seconds before retrying, respecting Retry-After. Team is limited to 60 requests per minute per workspace. [API-01]

metadata.reference_rationale: Header value specifies wait; current shared limit applies.
